name: embodied-ai-radar
description: 具身智能研究雷达：可追溯研究数据库、月度趋势与全球研究组织

scripts.generate: node scripts/generate-site.mjs && node scripts/generate-v2-pages.mjs && node scripts/generate-research-agenda.mjs && node scripts/generate-research-groups.mjs && python3 scripts/generate_x_weekly.py
scripts.v3:site: node scripts/generate-v3-site.mjs && node scripts/build-visual-catalog.mjs && node scripts/build-equipment-cards.mjs
scripts.v3:audit: node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/audit_v3.py && node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/audit_equipment.py
scripts.v3:audit-site: node scripts/audit_v3_site.mjs && node scripts/audit-visual-catalog.mjs && node scripts/audit-equipment-frequency.mjs
scripts.v3:prepare: npm run v3:export && python3 scripts/export_token_free_public.py && npm run v3:site && npm run v3:audit && npm run audit:groups
scripts.test:v3: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && node --test tests/v3-*.test.mjs
scripts.docs:build: npm run v3:prepare && npm run typecheck && vitepress build docs && npm run v3:search
scripts.test: npm run test:v3 && npm run v3:prepare && npm run typecheck && vitepress build docs && npm run v3:search && npm run v3:audit-site && npm run v3:audit-search
